import json,pathlib,hashlib,base64,zlib,struct,time
from fractions import Fraction as F
t=time.perf_counter();root=pathlib.Path('.');r=json.loads((root/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-ARGUMENT-PI-RN64-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
run=r['run'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
assert len(raw)==run['stdout_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256'] and run['rc']==0
a=json.loads(raw);lo=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510');hi=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
TWOPI=0x401921fb54442d18
def val(w):
 assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<2**64
 e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&(2**52-1);assert e!=2047 and not(e==0 and m)
 return F(*struct.unpack('<d',struct.pack('<Q',w))[0].as_integer_ratio())
def nearest(q,w):
 v=val(w)
 if q==0:assert v==0;return
 d=abs(q-v)
 for nw in [w-1,w+1]:
  if not 0<=nw<2**64:continue
  ne=(nw>>52)&2047
  if ne==2047:continue
  nv=F(*struct.unpack('<d',struct.pack('<Q',nw))[0].as_integer_ratio());nd=abs(q-nv)
  assert d<=nd,(q,w,nw)
  if d==nd:assert (w&1)==0
def integer(ws):
 assert isinstance(ws,list) and len(ws)==8 and all(type(v) is int and 0<=v<2**32 for v in ws)
 n=sum(v*2**(32*i) for i,v in enumerate(ws));return n-2**256 if n>=2**255 else n
p=val(TWOPI);nearest(lo+hi,TWOPI)
constant=max(abs(p-2*lo),abs(p-2*hi));nodes=casts=0
def verify(m):
 global nodes,casts
 n=integer(m['residual_signed256_words']);assert abs(n)<=2**146
 x=F(n,2**149);c=m['conversion'];w=c['output_uint64'];v=val(w);nearest(x,w);casts+=1
 assert F(*m['original_residual_rational'])==x and F(*m['represented_residual_rational'])==v
 cast=abs(v-x);assert F(*m['residual_conversion_error_cycles_rational'])==cast
 shift=max(abs(n).bit_length()-53,0);rem=abs(n)%(2**shift);tie=shift>0 and 2*rem==2**shift
 up=shift>0 and (2*rem>2**shift or (tie and ((abs(n)//2**shift)&1)!=0))
 assert c['discard_shift']==shift and c['discarded_integer']==rem and c['tie']==tie and c['rounded_up']==up
 assert m['TWO_PI_uint64']==TWOPI and F(*m['TWO_PI_error_bound_rad_per_cycle_rational'])==constant
 assert len(m['operations'])==m['RN64_operations']==1
 o=m['operations'][0];assert o['label']=='argument.mul_2pi' and o['op']=='mul'
 assert list(map(lambda q:F(*q),o['inputs_rational']))==[v,p]
 y=val(o['output_uint64']);nearest(v*p,o['output_uint64']);delta=y-v*p;nodes+=1
 assert F(*o['rounding_delta_rational'])==delta
 assert m['argument_uint64']==o['output_uint64'] and F(*m['observed_argument_rad_rational'])==y and abs(y)<=1
 charges={k:F(*q) for k,q in m['angle_error_charges_rad_rational'].items()}
 assert charges==dict(residual_conversion=abs(p)*cast,constant_2pi=abs(x)*constant,multiply_RN64=abs(delta))
 bound=sum(charges.values(),F(0));assert bound==F(*m['angle_error_upper_rad_rational'])
 assert max(abs(y-2*lo*x),abs(y-2*hi*x))<=bound
 assert not(m['GPU_executed'] or m['ALU_executed'] or m['native_argument_product_implemented'] or m['accepted_full_field_pipeline'])
 return y
prevf='coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-SELECTOR-INT256-001-CODEX.json'
assert hashlib.sha256((root/prevf).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='8ca986be04cb454c75e9c84ab68eb9442cafe711547bb30510ee069e80e16219'
prev=json.loads((root/prevf).read_bytes())
for f,h in prev['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
assert a['audit']['pins_verified']==prev['code_doc_sha256']
def old(f):
 b=json.loads((root/('coordinacion/respuestas/'+f+'-CODEX.json')).read_bytes());c=b['run'];v=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(c['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
 assert hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()==c['stdout_sha256'] and len(v)==c['stdout_bytes']
 return json.loads(v)['audit']['cases']
olds=old('AXIAL-SELECTOR-INT256-001');phases=old('AXIAL-PHASE-QUOTIENT-001')
cases=a['audit']['cases'];assert set(cases)==set(olds) and len(cases)==18
paths=partial=full=0;metrics={}
for name,c in cases.items():
 oldc=olds[name];pc=phases[name]
 for key in ['original_scene_binding_sha256','decoded_scene_binding_sha256']:assert c[key]==oldc[key]==pc[key]
 assert c['previous_full_case_accepted']==oldc['previous_full_case_accepted']
 assert c['previous_integer_selector_accepted']==oldc['accepted_integer_selector_CPU_only']
 assert not c['accepted_full_field_pipeline'] and not c['field_values_computed'] and not c['native_argument_product_implemented']
 full+=c['previous_full_case_accepted'];flags=[];count=0
 assert len(c['paths'])==len(oldc['paths'])==len(pc['paths'])
 for new,oldp,pp in zip(c['paths'],oldc['paths'],pc['paths']):
  assert new['source_id']==oldp['source_id']==pp['source_id'] and new['phase_reference_id']==oldp['phase_reference_id']==pp['phase_reference_id']
  assert new['previous_phase_argument_accepted']==oldp['previous_phase_argument_accepted']
  assert new['previous_RN32_unit_accepted']==oldp['previous_unit_accepted']
  admitted=oldp.get('selector',{}).get('accepted_CPU_integer_selector_only',False)
  assert new['argument_evaluated']==admitted
  if not admitted:assert 'measurement' not in new;flags.append(False);continue
  count+=1;paths+=1;s=oldp['selector'];m=new['measurement']
  assert m['residual_signed256_words']==s['residual_cycles_signed256_words']
  assert new['integer_turn']==s['integer_turn'] and new['quarter_index']==s['quarter_index']
  y=verify(m);up=F(*pp['composed_phase_bound_rad']);budget=F(*pp['phase_budget_rad']);bound=up+F(*m['angle_error_upper_rad_rational'])
  assert new['retained_phase_bound_rad']==pp['composed_phase_bound_rad'] and new['phase_budget_rad']==pp['phase_budget_rad']
  assert bound==F(*new['composed_phase_bound_rad'])
  flag=oldp['previous_phase_argument_accepted'] and pp['accepted_phase_argument_CPU_only'] and bound<=budget
  assert new['accepted_argument_CPU_only']==flag;flags.append(flag)
  original=F(*pp['original_length_BU'])/F(*pp['wavelength_BU_rational'])-s['integer_turn']-F(s['quarter_index'],4)
  oracle=max(abs(y-2*lo*original),abs(y-2*hi*original))
  assert oracle<=bound,(name,oracle,bound)
  if name=='nonquarter_FAIL':metrics={'nonquarter_angle_charge_rad_approx':float(F(*m['angle_error_upper_rad_rational'])),'nonquarter_composed_phase_bound_rad_approx':float(bound),'nonquarter_original_length_oracle_upper_rad_approx':float(oracle),'nonquarter_phase_budget_rad_approx':float(budget)}
 assert count==c['RN64_operations']
 assert c['accepted_argument_CPU_only']==all(flags)
 partial+=c['accepted_argument_CPU_only']
for m in a['primitives'].values():verify(m)
assert paths==21 and partial==17 and full==8 and a['conversion_oracle_checks']==96
assert len(a['primitives'])==10 and nodes==31 and casts==31
assert a['primitives']['domain_0']['argument_uint64']==0 and a['primitives']['domain_1']['argument_uint64']!=0
print(json.dumps(dict(validated=True,retained_cases=18,retained_paths=paths,partial_argument_pass=partial,previous_fullcase_accepted=full,previous_FAIL=18-full,full_field_promotions=0,pins=73,RN64_multiply_nodes=nodes,bit_conversions_verified=casts,primitive_cases=10,conversion_oracle_checks=96,original_length_phase_oracles=paths,raw_sha256=run['stdout_sha256'],elapsed_s=time.perf_counter()-t,**metrics)))
